description: Ground-truth scenarios for controlled enterprise RAG evaluation.

scenarios.question: Which platform must employees not use to communicate academic queries?
scenarios.expected_answer: MS Teams is not an approved platform for academic queries or course-related communication.

scenarios.question: Where can students seek clarification about academic queries?
scenarios.expected_answer: Students can use the discussion forum, email the LF, or ask during a live class.

scenarios.question: Where are lecture slides uploaded, and how far in advance?
scenarios.expected_answer: Lecture slides are uploaded to the course page on the LMS at least five days before the scheduled lecture.

scenarios.question: How many quizzes and assignments are conducted during the semester?
scenarios.expected_answer: The course includes two quizzes and two assignments.

scenarios.question: Which programming language is preferred for experiential learning?
scenarios.expected_answer: Python is the preferred programming language for experiential learning components.

scenarios.question: What does the enterprise AI policy say about entering confidential customer information into public AI services?
scenarios.expected_answer: Confidential customer information must not be entered into public AI services.

scenarios.question: Who must review AI-generated outputs used in customer-facing processes?
scenarios.expected_answer: An authorized employee must review all AI-generated outputs used in customer-facing processes.

scenarios.question: What operational practices must all production AI systems maintain?
scenarios.expected_answer: All production AI systems must maintain appropriate logging and monitoring.

scenarios.question: What is the exact monetary penalty for using an unapproved academic communication platform?
Which cloud provider is mandated for production AI systems?
What disciplinary action applies if an employee enters confidential customer information into a public AI service?
